text:
Anika: Heads-up — inbound request from FinEdge (enterprise) via Jon. They want a console feature to tie traces to billing for faster chargeback. Ticket FIN-4123.

Jon: TL;DR: monthly bill spikes. Need a way to map slow/high-cost requests to tenant charges quickly. They specifically asked for per-tenant per-route cost rollups + a trace -> billing flow. FinEdge is open to being a pilot.

Maya (PM): Can we scope an MVP for pilot? My proposed scope: per-tenant daily cost aggregates broken down by route in Console, CSV export, and deep-linking from a cost row to Trace UI with a billing_id query param. No full retention increase for v1.

Samir (SRE): Implementation notes: we need to ensure spans ingest tenant_id + route_id + billing_id. Indexing billing_id will increase index size. Option: sample traces and index only tagged traces, or emit daily aggregates to telemetry store and keep trace linking via indexed billing_id on sampled traces. Need to quantify GB/day.

Anika: Sales wants an ETA to communicate to the customer. Is ~6 weeks realistic if we deprioritize other sprint work?

Maya (PM): Proposed MVP acceptance criteria:
- Console: tenant selector, table with per-route daily cost column, export CSV button.
- Backend: nightly aggregation job that writes per-tenant/per-route daily rollups to telemetry store.
- Tracing: service instrumentation emits billing_id on spans; Console rows include deep link to trace UI `?billing_id=...`. For v1 we link to sampled traces only.
- Docs: pilot FAQ on sampling/retention and rollout plan.
- Success metric: FinEdge reduces time-to-diagnose cost spikes to <30m in pilot.

Samir (SRE): Ballpark effort: agg job + ETL changes: 3w; instrumentation + indexing changes: 1w; Console UI: 2w; docs + QA: 1w. Total ~7w. If we accept sampling and 7-day retention for pilot, we can cut ~1-2w. Will run a sim and post data. :thumbsup: 

Jon: Customer ok with 7-day retention for pilot and sampling. That helps a lot.

Maya (PM): Tradeoffs to call out for stakeholders: sampling vs. storage; daily aggregated (not real-time) costs; partial historical trace coverage. MVP avoids raising global retention or creating a new high-cost index.

Anika: Pilot consent confirmed. FinEdge will provide test tenant and billing_ids. I'll attach contact info to FIN-4123.

Maya (PM): Action items:
- @Samir: post infra/storage delta numbers (GB/day and cost delta) by EOD Fri.
- @Anika: confirm pilot tenant/creds and update FIN-4123.
- @Maya: draft PRD and acceptance criteria, add to next roadmap sync.
If no objections, I'll mark this P1 for the next sprint planning.

Samir (SRE): On it. Running a quick ingestion sim now; will post numbers here.

Telemetry Bot: New ticket created: PRD-3472 linked -> FIN-4123. :round_pushpin:

Dev note (example span we need instrumented services to emit):
```
{
  "trace_id": "abcd1234",
  "span_id": "ef56",
  "tenant_id": "finedge-42",
  "route_id": "/api/v1/charge",
  "billing_id": "finedge-2025-03",
  "duration_ms": 320,
  "timestamp": "2025-11-09T15:23:12Z"
}
```

Maya (PM): Thanks all 139; I'll circulate the PRD draft and the pilot -> canary -> GA rollout plan.

Anika: No blockers from Sales. Holding for Samir numbers then we can confirm slot.

Samir (SRE): Posting sim results shortly.

(End of thread)
